heading: INT. DROWNED CATHEDRAL - LIBRARY NAVE - TWILIGHT

units.text: INT. DROWNED CATHEDRAL - LIBRARY NAVE - TWILIGHT
Water laps at the knees of marble saints.
Long shelves rise out of the green dark, their books swollen and glowing faintly with lichen light.
Shafts of drowned moonlight fall through a broken rose window, and in them drift motes like slow fish.
KAELEN ASHDOWN, 20s, wades chest-deep with a lantern held high.
A scholar's coat floats around her like a jellyfish.
Her braid is plastered to her neck.
SELUNE ORRIN, 30s, pale as milk, surfaces from the water by the pulpit without a ripple.
She wears a grey shift that moves as if underwater even when she is not.
Her eyes are the colour of old pearl.
OLD BRAM, 80s, sits on a toppled bookshelf above the waterline, whittling a reed pipe, one bare foot dangling.
You are not supposed to be awake.
units.name: KAELEN

units.text: You are not supposed to be here.
units.name: SELUNE

units.text: I've come for the Index.
units.name: KAELEN

units.text: You've come to steal it.
units.name: SELUNE

units.text: SELUNE It belongs to the living. It belongs to the drowned.
units.name: KAELEN

units.text: You both sound very sure.
units.name: OLD BRAM

units.text: They stop.
A silence, thick as water.
Selune drifts closer, circling Kaelen, her shift trailing silt.
Kaelen lifts the lantern between them.
The flame shivers but does not die.
Then let me read it. One page.
units.name: KAELEN

units.text: Which?
units.name: SELUNE

units.text: My mother's.
units.name: KAELEN

units.text: Selune's expression changes, something old and tender breaking through the stillness.
Aye, there it is.
units.name: OLD BRAM

units.text: Selune reaches under the water and draws out a book, black with age and fat with brine.
She offers it.
Kaelen takes it.
Their fingers touch and both flinch, as if from cold.
They stand a long moment, the book between them, the lantern light swaying across the ruined nave.
Then Kaelen opens it.
The pages are blank except for one line, written in a hand she knows.
She waited.
units.name: KAELEN

units.text: Every night.
units.name: SELUNE

units.text: Old Bram tucks the whittled pipe behind his ear and slides down off the shelf, landing with a splash.
Right. Tea?
units.name: OLD BRAM
